comment: Repositories deployed to the dev environment by sync_dev_environment.py.
The list is derived from the lambdas and ECS services described in the
'Creating a TDR environment from scratch' service recovery documentation.
Each entry may declare:
repository: the GitHub repository name (required)
workflow:   the workflow file to dispatch (defaults to deploy.yml)
version_input: the name of the workflow input taking the version
(defaults to to-deploy)
version_inputs: where a workflow takes more than one version input,
all of which are given the release-intg version
extra_inputs: any additional static inputs the workflow requires
enabled: set to false to skip the repository (see the todo field)
deployments: for repositories which deploy more than one artefact from
the same release tag, a list of extra_inputs/version_input
overrides, each dispatched separately
terraform_status_env: the name of an environment variable (set by the
calling workflow from a prior terraform plan job)
which must equal 'clean' for this service to be
deployed. Used for services whose deploy also
applies terraform, where an unrelated pending
plan makes an unattended apply unsafe.
